黄毛黄眼瞳的尤来亚，跟蛇精病诺亚，给萧岑的感觉真是像极了。

都对她没能延续萧岑的特质，表现出了极大的愤怒。

也都对离颂充满了质疑和敌意。

区别是，秦夙没能从诺亚口中获得任何有效的信息，只觉得那货品行恶劣，避之唯恐不及。

这个尤来亚，初次见面却直接丢给她这么大一个信息炸弹。

萧岑恨离颂？？

真的假的？

秦夙先忽略在自己面前，情绪喷薄，气的发疯，呼吸急促的黄毛。

转眸看向肖恩。

肖恩只是一味的捏着眉心叹气，也是心累到极点了。

她再回头看看魏知弦。

魏知弦薄唇抿起，与秦夙交汇的目光里，眸光游移不定，还多眨了几次眼睛，似乎并没有否认尤来亚的话的意思，反而……有点心虚。

蕾拉那姑娘就站在魏知弦旁边，秦夙再一眼，就看到她流露出了万分为难的神色，眼圈还有点泛红。

完蛋。

秦夙想，事情好像变得复杂起来了。

她可以不在乎别人对她提出：她必须要多像萧岑，她应该做萧岑尚未完成的事。

在秦夙看来这些要求是纯纯扯犊子。

可她不能不在意自己真正所处的环境，周围所环绕的人到底都是些什么牛鬼蛇神。

那可能直接关系到她未来的处境跟命运。

离颂、谢尘无、魏知弦……

秦夙冷静下来再仔细分析一下，很轻易就得到了一个结论。

从她来到这个世界开始，虽然跟离颂本人接触并不算多，但她事实上始终都处在离颂给她制造的信息茧房里。

接触的，都是离颂小队的人。

听到的信息，很少提及萧岑本人的意愿。

——“离长官和萧岑是同一个孤儿院里出来的。”

档案中心的人这么说。

——“如果当初萧岑向导编入离长官的队伍，可能就不会出那种意外了。”

是啊，为什么萧岑一开始不编入离颂小队？

是匹配度不满足条件？但这话是离颂暗示之下，秦夙这么以为的。

真相呢？

——“之前在队里，你跟我关系最好了啊！”

诺亚说的理所当然，秦夙当时觉得他纯鬼扯。

Uriah, who has yellow hair and yellow eyes, looks very similar to Noah, who is a snake spirit.

They all showed great anger at her failure to continue Xiao Cen's characteristics.

They were also full of doubts and hostility towards Li Song.

The difference is that Qin Su failed to get any effective information from Noah. He only felt that the product was of bad character and was afraid to avoid it.

This Uriah, when they first met, he dropped such a big information bomb on her.

Xiao Cen hates Li Song??

Real or fake?

Qin Suxian ignored the yellow hair in front of him, gushing out his emotions, going crazy with anger, and breathing rapidly.

Turning to look at Sean.

Sean just pinched his eyebrows and sighed, feeling extremely tired.

She looked back at Wei Zhixian.

Wei Zhixian pursed his thin lips, and when he met Qin Su's eyes, his eyes wandered uncertainly, and he blinked a few more times. It seemed that he did not deny the meaning of Yulaiya's words, but... felt a little guilty.

The girl Leila was standing next to Wei Zhixian. Qin Su looked at her again and saw that she looked extremely troubled and her eye circles were a little red.

Finished.

Qin Su thought that things seemed to be getting complicated.

She doesn't care what others say to her: she must be more like Xiao Cen, and she should do what Xiao Cen has not yet completed.

In Qin Su's opinion, these demands were pure nonsense.

But she couldn't help but care about the real environment she was in, and what kind of monsters and monsters the people around her were.

That may be directly related to her future situation and destiny.

Li Song, Xie Chenwu, Wei Zhixian...

Qin Su calmed down and analyzed it carefully, and easily came to a conclusion.

From the moment she came to this world, although she didn't have much contact with Lisa himself, she was actually always in the information cocoon created by Lisa for her.

Those who came into contact were all members of Lisong's team.

The information heard rarely mentioned Xiao Cen's own wishes.

——"Sir Li and Xiao Cen came from the same orphanage."

The people at the Archives Center said so.

——"If guide Xiao Cen had been included in Commander Li's team, there might not have been such an accident."

Yes, why didn't Xiao Cen join the Lisong team at the beginning?

Is the matching degree not meeting the conditions?But this was what Qin Su thought after being hinted by Li Song.

What's the truth?

——"You and I had the best relationship in the team before!"

What Noah said was natural, but Qin Su thought he was just lying.
